';clearTimeout(spriteTimer)}
function start(){g=initial();if(Number.isFinite(window.__tinyInheritedEnergy))g.energy=window.__tinyInheritedEnergy;phase='intro';dialogIndex=0;clearVisual();showCompanion('Sea');hud();showNext()}
function showNext(){phase='intro';if(dialogIndex>=DIALOGUE.length){return planChoice()}const [who,line]=DIALOGUE[dialogIndex++];if(['Sea','Catalyst','Mo'].includes(who))showCompanion(who);else if(who==='Savvy')showCompanion('Catalyst');$('guestChip').classList.remove('show');say(who,line);buttons([['NEXT ▶',showNext]])}
function planChoice(){phase='plan';$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');$('guestChip').classList.remove('show');$('speechName').textContent='TINY';$('speechText').textContent='How do we catch them without Noosh finding out?';setPanel('Choose the Plan','Different plans affect catching speed, energy, scoring, and how everyone reacts.','QUESTIONABLE RACCOON STRATEGY');buttons([['🍗 DINO NUGGIES',()=>choosePlan('nuggies')],['🐈 CAT, HELP!',()=>choosePlan('cat'),true],['🏃 CHASE THEM!',()=>choosePlan('sprint'),true]])}
function choosePlan(plan){g.plan=plan;if(plan==='nuggies'){earn(15);toast('🍗 The raccoons look hungry!')}else if(plan==='cat'){g.autoNet=1;points(80);toast('🐈 Cat promised to help catch one!')}else{points(180);toast('🏃 FULL CHAOS RUN!')};phase='ready';$('speechName').textContent='TINY';$('speechText').textContent='Nine holes. Three waves. What could possibly go wrong?';setPanel('The Great Raccoon Net','Tap popping-up raccoons, even two at once. Bonk Baba for bonus chaos. The 🔑 raccoon hops between holes.','THREE WAVES • NO GAME OVER');buttons([['BEGIN WAVE 1 ▶',()=>startWave(0)]])}
function resetWaveTimers(r){const ms=now();r.now=ms;r.countUntil=ms+COUNT_MS;r.goUntil=r.countUntil+GO_MS;r.spawnAt=r.goUntil+280;r.endAt=r.goUntil+PLAY_MS;r.lastFrame=ms;r.countLabel='';}
function waveContent(index){const deck=shuffle([{kind:'real'},{kind:'real'},{kind:'real'},{kind:'real'},{kind:'hat'}]);if(index===g.keyWave){const t=choose(deck.filter(x=>x.kind==='real'));t.key=true;const idx=deck.indexOf(t);if(idx>1){deck.splice(idx,1);deck.splice(1,0,t)}}return deck}
function startWave(index){clearTimeout(spriteTimer);$('tiny').src='data:image/webp;base64,';phase='wave';$('speech').classList.add('hidden');$('guestChip').classList.remove('show');$('report').classList.remove('show');$('flash').classList.remove('show');$('scene').className='playing';$('netBoard').classList.add('show');$('powers').classList.add('show');$('waveNumber').textContent=(index+1)+'/3';$('holeGrid').replaceChildren();const cells=[];for(let n=0;n<9;n++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='hole';b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Empty raccoon hole '+(n+1));b.dataset.slot=n;b.current=null;b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(b.current&&!g.paused){e.preventDefault();net(b.current)}});b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(b.current&&!g.paused)net(b.current)});$('holeGrid').append(b);cells.push(b)}
const r={index,cells,queue:waveContent(index),objects:[],realCaught:0,realMissed:0,hatsCaught:0,netNow:0,finished:false,spawnRate:g.plan==='sprint'?.85:g.plan==='nuggies'?1.14:1};round=r;resetWaveTimers(r);$('countdown').textContent='3';$('countdown').classList.add('show');$('countdown').classList.remove('go');$('clock').textContent='READY';setPanel('Get Your Net Ready','3, 2, 1, GO! Catch four raccoons this wave. Each hole is independently tappable.','🥅 WAVE '+(index+1)+' / 3');buttons([]);hud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
function placeObj(item,slot){const b=round.cells[slot];if(item.slot!==undefined)clearObj(item);item.slot=slot;b.current=item;b.classList.add('active');b.setAttribute('aria-label',item.kind==='hat'?'Baba peeking out! Tap to bonk him for bonus chaos':item.key?'Key-carrying raccoon':'Raccoon');b.innerHTML=item.kind==='hat'?'<span class="baba-pop"><img src="'+babaPopSprite+'" alt=""></span>':'<span class="raccoon'+(item.key?' key':'')+'">'+raccoonSVG+(item.key?'<span class="key-icon">🔑</span>':'')+'</span>'}
function clearObj(item){const b=round?.cells?.[item.slot];if(b&&b.current===item){b.current=null;b.classList.remove('active');b.innerHTML='';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Empty hole '+(item.slot+1))}}
function spawn(template,t){const r=round;const free=r.cells.map((b,i)=>b.current===null?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);if(!free.length)return false;const scale=r.spawnRate;const item={kind:template.kind,key:!!template.key,done:false,slot:undefined,firstSeen:t,endAt:t+(template.key?4100:template.kind==='hat'?2200:2900)*scale,hopAt:t+(template.key?1500:850+Math.random()*130)*scale};r.objects.push(item);placeObj(item,choose(free));return true}
function makePop(t){const r=round;if(!r.queue.length)return;const x=r.queue.shift();if(!spawn(x,t)){r.queue.unshift(x);return}if(x.key){const idx=r.queue.findIndex(o=>o.kind==='real'&&!o.key);if(idx>=0){const [second]=r.queue.splice(idx,1);spawn(second,t)}$('keyCue').classList.add('show');$('keyCue').textContent='🔑 TAP THE KEY!'}r.spawnAt=t+rand(980,1270)*r.spawnRate}
function expire(item){if(item.done)return;item.done=true;clearObj(item);if(item.kind==='real'){g.escaped++;g.misses++;round.realMissed++;hud();toast(item.key?'🔑 THE KEY RACCOON ESCAPED!':'💨 A RACCOON GOT AWAY!')}}
function frame(t){const r=round;if(phase!=='wave'||!r||r.finished)return;if(g.paused){const delta=Math.max(0,t-r.lastFrame);r.countUntil+=delta;r.goUntil+=delta;r.spawnAt+=delta;r.endAt+=delta;for(const x of r.objects){if(!x.done){x.endAt+=delta;x.hopAt+=delta}}r.lastFrame=t;raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);return}r.lastFrame=t;
if(t<r.countUntil){const val=String(Math.max(1,Math.ceil((r.countUntil-t)/1000)));if(val!==r.countLabel){$('countdown').textContent=val;r.countLabel=val;}raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);return}
if(t<r.goUntil){$('countdown').textContent='GO!';$('countdown').classList.add('go');$('clock').textContent='17.0';raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);return}
$('countdown').classList.remove('show');if(t>=r.spawnAt)makePop(t);
for(const o of r.objects){if(o.done)continue;if(o.key&&t>=o.hopAt){const free=r.cells.map((b,i)=>b.current===null?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);if(free.length)placeObj(o,choose(free));o.hopAt=t+rand(1450,1750)*r.spawnRate}if(g.autoNet>0&&o.kind==='real'){g.autoNet--;net(o,true);toast('🦝 CAT CAUGHT ONE FOR YOU!')}if(t>=o.endAt)expire(o)}
$('keyCue').classList.toggle('show',r.objects.some(o=>o.key&&!o.done));$('clock').textContent=Math.max(0,(r.endAt-t)/1000).toFixed(1);
if((r.queue.length===0&&r.objects.every(o=>o.done))||t>=r.endAt){if(t>=r.endAt)for(const x of r.objects)if(!x.done)expire(x);endWave();return}
raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
function impact(cell){if(!cell)return;const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='net-impact';el.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 80 80" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M49 51L75 77" stroke="#bd8a57" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/><ellipse cx="33" cy="32" rx="29" ry="27" fill="#d7fff02c" stroke="#ffefc3" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M10 14L56 51M5 30L41 57M26 5L62 34M54 10L9 49M36 6L6 36M61 31L27 58" stroke="#e6fff1" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/></svg>';cell.append(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),360)}
